articles.title: EPA to Repeal Power Plant Emission Rules, Sparking Legal Battle
articles.summary: The EPA is set to scrap limits on greenhouse gases from power plants. The agency says it will cut costs and boost energy. Critics warn of health risks and more climate damage.

articles.title: Evanston's Reparations Program Faces Federal Challenge
articles.summary: Evanston, Illinois, gave $25,000 grants to Black residents to address past housing discrimination. The Trump administration is now suing, saying the program is racially discriminatory.

articles.title: Farage Defends £72m Donations as Parliament Debates Cap
articles.summary: Reform UK received £72 million from two wealthy donors. Nigel Farage says the donations are legal, but a new bill could cap overseas donations and backdate the rule.
